instruction: A chunky voxel sailing ship built entirely from visible cubes, with a stepped brown hull, blocky gold-trimmed stern castle, and three masts of stacked tan pixels. Two square sails of off-white voxels bulge slightly, one stamped with a black skull-and-bones made of dark cubes, and a jagged pixel flag juts from the mainmast. Tiny cube cannons poke from square gunports along the hull side.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Voxel Pirate Galleon in a voxel/pixel style. A chunky voxel sailing ship built entirely from visible cubes, with a stepped brown hull, blocky gold-trimmed stern castle, and three masts of stacked tan pixels. Two square sails of off-white voxels bulge slightly, one stamped with a black skull-and-bones made of dark cubes, and a jagged pixel flag juts from the mainmast. Tiny cube cannons poke from square gunports along the hull side. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
